name: ImageGrid
summary: A set of pictures arranged as one: equal frames, a quilt with features, masonry columns or justified rows. Each layout keeps every column at least `c.image-grid.min` wide and falls to fewer as the place narrows, so nothing scrolls sideways. With `onSelect`, a picture opens (into a Lightbox). With `selectable`, pictures are chosen with a check box each (an album being edited). With `onItemsDragStart`, pictures (the chosen ones together) drag out of the grid. Items can carry badges, and a video's poster its play mark and length. For pictures one at a time use Carousel.
a11y: A list named by `label`; each picture keeps its own alternative text, followed by its badges and, for a video, "video" and its spoken length. With `onSelect` each is a button named "Open: " and that name, in reading order; the focus ring sits inside the picture's corners. With `selectable` each has a check box named "Select: " and that name, its own Tab stop after the picture's button; the check box carries the choice, the outline only shows it. Masonry reads down each column, so use it only where order doesn't matter. An item's href makes its tile a native link, followed with Enter; selection controls remain separate siblings.

keys.action: the next picture or check box
open the picture; Space on a check box chooses it or takes it out

props.name: items
props.description: The pictures, in reading order.

props.name: layout
props.description: `standard`: equal frames in rows (default). `quilted`: square cells, some pictures across two (a feature). `masonry`: columns of whole pictures, each its own height. `justified`: rows of whole pictures at one height, filling the width.

props.name: ratio
props.description: In `standard`, the frames' shape.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Makes each picture a button that opens it, with its index (for a Lightbox).

props.name: label
props.description: What the set is: names the list for screen readers ("Photos from the trip").

props.name: framed
props.description: The pictures carry framing art (items' `under`, `decoration` and `room`): the gap is `--c-image-grid-framed-gap` (default the usual gap; each picture keeps its art in its own box).

props.name: selectable
props.description: Pictures can be chosen (an editor's album, a picker): each gets a check box at its top start corner, shown while the picture is pointed at or focused and whenever any is chosen (always on touch screens). A press on a picture chooses it alone, Ctrl or Cmd adds or takes it out, Shift chooses the run from the last one chosen; with `onSelect` a plain press opens it instead, and choosing is the check box's (or the modifier keys').

props.name: selected
props.description: The chosen items' ids (with `selectable`): each gets the selection outline and a checked box.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: The chosen ids after a press, with how it was made.

props.name: onItemsDragStart
props.description: Makes the pictures draggable (an editor dragging them somewhere else, such as into a cover): a drag carries the chosen items, in the grid's order, when it starts on a chosen one, else the one under the pointer. Called with those ids and the drag event (put the ids on `event.dataTransfer` under your own type); the dragged items dim until the drag ends. The drag allows a move. Off by default.

props.name: onItemsDragEnd
props.description: The drag that `onItemsDragStart` began ended (dropped or cancelled).

props.name: reorderable
props.description: The pictures can be put in order by dragging them within the grid (an album being arranged): the dragged items (the chosen ones together, as `onItemsDragStart`) go just before the item under the pointer, or the one after it when the pointer is past its middle, else at the end. While dragging, the grid draws a line in the gap on the start edge of the item they'd go before (past the last item for the end). Only drags that began in this grid are taken; a drop on one of the dragged items does nothing. Give a keyboard way too (Move earlier, Move later). Off by default.

props.name: onReorder
props.description: The dragged ids (in grid order) dropped just before `before`, or at the end when it's `null`.

props.name: onDropFiles
props.description: Files dragged in from outside (the desktop) land where they're dropped (an album being filled): the grid marks the same line and takes the same place as a reorder (before the item under the pointer, the next one past its middle, else the end), and offers a copy. Called with the files and the id they go before, or `null` for the end. Off by default.

props.name: dropFilesAnywhere
props.description: With `onDropFiles`, files dropped anywhere else on the page (outside a dialog, and not taken by something else first) land at the end, the end marked while they're over the page. For the one grid a screen fills. Off by default.

props.name: loading
props.description: LR66 (opt-in): the pictures are loading. This many frames of shimmer (core Skeleton, block) stand in the grid's own layout and ratio in place of `items`, so nothing moves when the pictures arrive. The list is `aria-busy`; the region around it still says once what is loading.

props.name: tone
props.description: As Badge's `tone`; the words always say it too. Default `neutral`.

props.name: icon
props.description: LR120 (opt-in): the badge is this icon alone, a small round mark (as the play mark), with `label` as its spoken name, read in the tile's name. For what an item is at a glance (a video, its source). Default none: the words.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable key. Also what `selected` and `onSelectionChange` name the item by.

props.name: href
props.description: Opens the whole tile as a native link, instead of the `onSelect` lightbox button. Selection controls stay separate.

props.name: src
props.description: The picture's address (for a video, its poster: a still from it).

props.name: fallbackSrc
props.description: As Image: a second address tried once if the picture fails to load. Default none.

props.name: fit
props.description: As Image: cover crops to fill the frame (default); contain keeps the whole picture.

props.name: alt
props.description: What the picture shows. Also the name of its button when the grid opens pictures.

props.name: width
props.description: The picture's own width and height in pixels: `justified` and `masonry` keep its shape from them.

props.name: span
props.description: In `quilted`, a picture that takes two columns (`wide`), two rows (`tall`) or both (`large`).

props.name: treatment
props.description: As `Image`: its tone, or one at rest and one while hovered or focused (grey until pointed at).

props.name: alternate
props.description: As `Image`: the paired picture shown while it's hovered or focused.

props.name: reveal
props.description: As `Image`: draws the change to `alternate` yourself (a template's reveal preset).

props.name: caption
props.description: Words under the picture, in `standard` and `masonry` (quilted and justified tiles leave them out).

props.name: credit
props.description: Who made it, after the caption.

props.name: focal
props.description: As `Image`: the point kept in view where a frame crops.

props.name: decoration
props.description: As `Image`: shapes drawn over the picture (a template's framing art).

props.name: under
props.description: As `Image`: shapes drawn behind the picture.

props.name: room
props.description: As `Image`: room kept around the picture for its art, so the art stays in the item's own box.

props.name: badges
props.description: Badges at the picture's top end corner, read after its description.

props.name: kind
props.description: `video`: the picture is a video's poster, marked as MediaPlayer marks one (a play mark and its length). Default `picture`.

props.name: duration
props.description: A video's length in seconds, shown at the poster's foot (with or without `kind: 'video'`'s play mark) and spoken in its name.

props.name: progress
props.description: The picture is still arriving (an upload): a Progress bar across the foot of its tile, named "Uploading: " and its description. A number is the share done, 0-100, as Progress's `value`, from a real total; `indeterminate` while the total isn't known (the server is working). Left out, no bar.

props.name: status
props.description: LR71 (opt-in): a short line inside the tile, at its foot (over the upload bar when there is one): a file's name while it arrives, or why it was refused. Read with the picture's name. `statusTone="danger"` marks a refusal.

props.name: blank
props.description: LR71 (opt-in): a file that isn't a picture yet (uploading, or refused): the tile is a blank surface at the grid's ratio with this icon in its middle (in the danger colour with `statusTone="danger"`), in place of `src`.

settings.description: Between pictures in a framed grid (framed; a media block with its frame switch on). Default space.2, the usual gap: each picture keeps its art in its own box (Image room). A template whose framed pictures read crowded sets more.

A quilted grid's square cell (layout quilted): the narrowest a cell gets, so as many columns as fit (default 8rem). A template whose quilted pattern needs a fixed column count sets a share of the width with a floor, e.g. four: max(8rem, calc((100% - 3 * var(--c-image-grid-gap)) / 4 - 1px)).
